finding: With the same exact message, Menu path and multiplicity, 29b781d accepts copying one warning activity in place of the other. The duplicate reuses its original issue attachment UUID.
correction: Require a canonical hyphenated UUID on the sole Complete Issue Description.txt attachment and reject repeat UUIDs case-insensitively within the warning activity run. Detail and activity attachment identifiers are independent.
hostedSchemaValidation: Both fresh unmodified Xcode 26.3 positive Menu exports had distinct UUIDs and passed identity validation with their omitted optional parent activityType. Standalone diagnostic selectors are outside the product allowance.
realMutation: The candidate rejects same-count repeated attachment UUIDs, including with different letter casing, and missing or malformed UUIDs. Both checkers accept the original two distinct activities.
scope: Installed after root review; saved evidence replay only. Fresh hosted verification pending.
